title: Add workflow_dispatch deploy workflows for Auth and staging/production stacks
description:
Development already has workflow_dispatch workflows for Web and ThinTurn. Auth and the staging/production named stacks still require a laptop CDK deploy.

**Do:** Add workflow_dispatch GitHub Actions workflows (same OIDC pattern as `.github/workflows/deploy-web-development.yml` and `deploy-thinturn-development.yml`) so an operator can dispatch named-stack deploys for Auth and for staging/production without a local CDK session. Add any missing `infra/deploy-chatticus-*.sh` wrappers the workflows need.

**Do not:** auto-deploy on push to develop/main; run the workflows from the implementing PR; `cdk deploy --all`; merge to main.

**Done when:** Auth and staging/production named stacks can be deployed from GitHub Actions `workflow_dispatch`, matching the existing development Web/ThinTurn pattern.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Planning: Composer 2.5. Mirror existing development Web/ThinTurn workflow_dispatch + OIDC. No auto-deploy on push. Do not run the new workflows from the PR.
